1.name: CP1
1.hint: charge pump flying capacitor: 0.01 µF rated 50 V (layout: rated for VM) between CP1 and CP2, close to the pins

2.name: CP2
2.hint: charge pump flying capacitor: 0.01 µF rated 50 V (layout: rated for VM) between CP1 and CP2, close to the pins

3.name: VCP
3.hint: high-side gate drive: a 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor rated 16 V and a 1 MΩ resistor from VCP to VM (VMA), not to GND

4.name: VMA
4.hint: motor supply 8.2 … 45 V; VMA and VMB on the same supply; supply ramp rate ≤ 1 V/µs (absolute maximum)

needs.source: TI SLVSA73F pin functions p. 3 and 10 power supply recommendations: a 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor rated for VM on each of VMA and VMB, as close as possible, plus bulk capacitance sized by the application (10.1)

5.name: AOUT1
5.hint: bridge output (N-channel FETs): Z when nENBL is high, in sleep and reset (pin functions); overcurrent protection on every FET for a short to ground, to supply and across the winding – the device then stays off until nRESET or a VM cycle (8.3.7.1)

6.name: ISENA
6.hint: bridge ground: to the current-sense resistor (ICHOP = VREF / (5 × R)); absolute maximum ±0.8 V (±1 V for < 25 ns)

7.name: AOUT2
7.hint: bridge output (N-channel FETs): Z when nENBL is high, in sleep and reset (pin functions); overcurrent protection on every FET for a short to ground, to supply and across the winding – the device then stays off until nRESET or a VM cycle (8.3.7.1)

8.name: BOUT2
8.hint: bridge output (N-channel FETs): Z when nENBL is high, in sleep and reset (pin functions); overcurrent protection on every FET for a short to ground, to supply and across the winding – the device then stays off until nRESET or a VM cycle (8.3.7.1)

9.name: ISENB
9.hint: bridge ground: to the current-sense resistor (ICHOP = VREF / (5 × R)); absolute maximum ±0.8 V (±1 V for < 25 ns)

10.name: BOUT1
10.hint: bridge output (N-channel FETs): Z when nENBL is high, in sleep and reset (pin functions); overcurrent protection on every FET for a short to ground, to supply and across the winding – the device then stays off until nRESET or a VM cycle (8.3.7.1)

11.name: VMB
11.hint: motor supply 8.2 … 45 V; VMA and VMB on the same supply; supply ramp rate ≤ 1 V/µs (absolute maximum)

needs.source: TI SLVSA73F pin functions p. 3 and 10 power supply recommendations: a 0.1 µF ceramic capacitor rated for VM on each of VMA and VMB, as close as possible, plus bulk capacitance sized by the application (10.1)

12.name: AVREF
12.hint: current set reference: ICHOP = VREF / (5 × RISENSE) (8.3.2); recommended 1 … 3.5 V, operational from 0 V with degraded accuracy; may be tied to V3P3OUT

13.name: BVREF
13.hint: current set reference: ICHOP = VREF / (5 × RISENSE) (8.3.2); recommended 1 … 3.5 V, operational from 0 V with degraded accuracy; may be tied to V3P3OUT

15.name: V3P3OUT
15.hint: 3.3 V regulator output (3.2 … 3.4 V), load 1 mA max (recommended operating conditions) – enough for AVREF/BVREF dividers

needs.source: TI SLVSA73F pin functions p. 3: bypass to GND with a 0.47 µF 6.3 V ceramic capacitor (11.1: as close to the pin as possible)

16.name: nRESET
16.hint: active-low reset: initialises the indexer and disables the outputs; internal pull-down – left open the outputs stay off

17.name: nSLEEP
17.hint: logic high enables the device, low = sleep; internal pull-down – left open it sleeps; 1.7 ms max until STEP is accepted after wake-up (7.6)

18.name: nFAULT
18.hint: open drain, low on overtemperature or overcurrent; VOL ≤ 0.5 V at 5 mA

19.name: DECAY
19.hint: low = slow, open = mixed, high = fast decay; internal 130 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V and 80 kΩ pull-down (8.3.3)

21.name: NENBL
21.hint: nENBL: high disables outputs and indexer, low enables; internal pull-down – enabled when open

22.name: STEP
22.hint: rising edge = one step; up to 250 kHz, high and low ≥ 1.9 µs, MODE/DIR set-up and hold 650 ns (7.6)

27.name: nHOME
27.hint: open drain, low at the home state of the step table

sources: TI DRV8825 Stepper Motor Controller IC, SLVSA73F (April 2010, revised July 2014), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/drv8825.pdf, read 2026-10-31

pins: p. 3–4 pin functions (numbers 1 … 28; the pin configuration drawing is an image) = EasyEDA symbol of C81582 (edakit part import 2026-10-31; nENBL is named NENBL there); the symbol has no pin for the PowerPAD, the footprint has it as pad 29

absolute maximum 7.1 p. 4: VMx -0.3 … 47 V (vdd_max_v, VM v_max_v), ramp ≤ 1 V/µs, digital pins -0.5 … 7 V (input v_max_v), xVREF -0.3 … 4 V (AVREF/BVREF v_max_v), ISENSEx -0.8 … 0.8 V (±1 V < 25 ns), continuous output current 2.5 A (i_out_max_a; 'power dissipation and thermal limits must be observed'), TJ -40 … 150 °C

recommended 7.3 p. 4: VMx 8.2 … 45 V (vdd_op_min_v, vdd_op_max_v), VREF 1 … 3.5 V ('operational at VREF between 0 to 1 V, but accuracy is degraded' – AVREF/BVREF v_op 0 … 3.5 V), V3P3OUT load 0 … 1 mA
rth_ja_k_per_w 31.6: 7.4 thermal information, PWP (JEDEC high-K board, simulated); t_min_c -40, t_max_c 85: package option addendum, DRV8825PWPR

electrical 7.5 p. 6: IVM 8 mA max at 24 V (idd_max_a), VIL ≤ 0.7 V, VIH ≥ 2.2 V (vih_v, vil_v; VIH max 5.25 V), RPD 100 kΩ typ, DECAY VIL 0.8 / VIH 2 V with 130 kΩ pull-up and 80 kΩ pull-down, nFAULT/nHOME open drain VOL 0.5 V at 5 mA, RDS(on) HS and LS 0.2 Ω typ at 25 °C, 0.25 typ / 0.32 Ω max at 85 °C (r_out_ohm 0.32), IOCP ≥ 3 A, V3P3 3.2 … 3.4 V
capacitors: pin functions p. 3, 10 power supply recommendations and 11.1 layout: 0.1 µF on each VM pin plus bulk, 0.01 µF CP1–CP2, 0.1 µF 16 V plus 1 MΩ VCP–VMA, 0.47 µF 6.3 V on V3P3OUT
LCSC product data C81582 (2026-10-31): TI DRV8825PWPR, HTSSOP-28-EP, 11 842 pcs; JLCPCB catalogue 2026-10-31: Extended Part, 12 700 pcs
notes: Bipolar stepper driver with STEP/DIR indexer up to 1/32 step, VM 8.2–45 V, 2.5 A per output at 24 V and 25 °C with heat sinking; logic runs from an internal regulator (V3P3OUT), inputs take 2.2 V high. nRESET, nSLEEP and nENBL have internal pull-downs: open nRESET or nSLEEP keeps the outputs off. Mostly bought as a carrier board (Pololu DRV8825 and StepStick-format clones) – this entry is the IC. No behaviour model for a bridge driver: behavior none. Library draft.

checked: pin functions pp. 3–4 = EasyEDA symbol of C81582 (1 CP1 … 28 GND, NENBL = nENBL)
absolute maximum p. 4: VM 47 V, digital pins 7 V, xVREF 4 V, ISENSE ±0.8 V, IOUT 2.5 A continuous, TJ 150 °C
recommended p. 4: VM 8.2 … 45 V, VREF 1 … 3.5 V, V3P3OUT ≤ 1 mA; RθJA 31.6 K/W
electrical p. 6: VIL 0.7 / VIH 2.2 V, pull-downs 100 kΩ, DECAY levels and pulls, RDS(on), IVM 8 mA, open-drain nFAULT/nHOME
capacitors p. 3, 10, 11.1: 0.1 µF per VM pin, 0.01 µF CP1–CP2, 0.1 µF + 1 MΩ VCP–VM, 0.47 µF V3P3OUT
OCP 8.3.7.1: shorts to ground, supply and across the winding
open: the PowerPAD (footprint pad 29) has no pin in the EasyEDA symbol, so the graph cannot hold it on ground; the datasheet's thermal data assume it soldered to a ground plane
CP1–CP2 and VCP–VM capacitors are not to ground – needs.capacitor cannot express them, pin hints only
two VM capacitors 'one on each pin': REQ.missing sums the capacitance on the net and cannot see where each sits

clamping of the outputs: the datasheet describes N-channel FET bridges with synchronous decay and shows no external diodes, but names no body-diode rating – no field in the schema anyway; REQ.missing (flyback) asks for a diode across a motor on an output pin – here a false finding
drive tristate makes a motor net driven only by these outputs an LVL.undefined/open_drain warning – no pin type fits a bridge output
supply ramp rate ≤ 1 V/µs and V3P3OUT's 1 mA load limit have no field (pin hints)
r_out_ohm is one number; the datasheet gives a maximum only at TJ = 85 °C
i_out_max_a 2.5 A needs heat sinking (24 V, 25 °C) – the thermal limit is LIM.t's through RθJA
